misconception.remediation_hint: A number smaller than 1 always has a NEGATIVE index.

misconception.label: Value is right but it is not in standard form

worked_solution: 0.004 18 -> move the decimal point 3 places to the right to get 4.18. Moving right for a number less than 1 gives a negative index. 0.004 18 = 4.18 × 10^-3.
